title: Can You Beat This 9 Question Quiz?
hook: Are you smarter than most people?
script:
Are you smarter than most people?
Question 1: What is the largest land animal?
Lock in your answer: Three. Two. One.
The answer is A: African Elephant.
Question 2: Which continent is the Sahara Desert located on?
Lock in your answer: Three. Two. One.
The answer is B: Africa.
Question 3: What gas do plants absorb from the atmosphere?
Lock in your answer: Three. Two. One.
The answer is C: Carbon Dioxide.
If you got the first three right, like the video right now.
Question 4: Who was the first emperor of Rome?
Lock in your answer: Three. Two. One.
The answer is B: Augustus.
Question 5: Which movie features a talking green ogre named Shrek?
Lock in your answer: Three. Two. One.
The answer is C: Shrek.
Score check: comment SHARP if you are still perfect, RUSTY if you already missed one.
Question 6: Which ocean is the largest and deepest on Earth?
Lock in your answer: Three. Two. One.
The answer is D: Pacific Ocean.
Question 7: When did the Titanic sink?
Lock in your answer: Three. Two. One.
The answer is B: 1912.
Question 8: Who played the character of Indiana Jones?
Lock in your answer: Three. Two. One.
The answer is A: Harrison Ford.
Are you ready for the last question? Don't forget to follow and comment your score to be on the weekly leaderboard of the top performers.
Question 9: How many planets are in our solar system?
Lock in your answer: Three. Two. One.
The answer is B: 8.
Comment your score out of 9, and follow for a new quiz every day.

items.question: What is the largest land animal?
items.explanation: The African elephant is the largest living land animal by mass.

items.question: Which continent is the Sahara Desert located on?
items.explanation: The Sahara is the largest hot desert in the world, covering much of North Africa.

items.question: What gas do plants absorb from the atmosphere?
items.explanation: Plants use carbon dioxide during photosynthesis to create energy.

items.question: Who was the first emperor of Rome?
items.explanation: Augustus, born Octavian, was the founder of the Roman Principate and considered the first Roman emperor.

items.question: Which movie features a talking green ogre named Shrek?
items.explanation: Shrek is a beloved animated film from DreamWorks Animation, first released in 2001.

items.question: Which ocean is the largest and deepest on Earth?
items.explanation: The Pacific Ocean covers about one-third of the surface of the Earth.

items.question: When did the Titanic sink?
items.explanation: The RMS Titanic sank in the North Atlantic Ocean on April 15, 1912, after striking an iceberg.

items.question: Who played the character of Indiana Jones?
items.explanation: Harrison Ford portrayed the iconic archaeologist in all four Indiana Jones films.

items.question: How many planets are in our solar system?
items.explanation: The eight planets in our solar system are Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, and Neptune.

comment: Score check: how many did you get right out of 9? Comment your score and which question tricked you.
